format_divergence.reason_en: Same reasoning as checkpoint 1. This module is receptive; a transform question would ask the learner to produce Hindi and an error-spot would present wrong Hindi to someone trained only to understand correct speech. Still flagged rather than settled — if the engine enforces the Part F mix, both checkpoints need reworking together.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Why does she need to borrow sugar?
options: Her usual shop had run out
The shop was shut and guests arrived
She is cooking for a festival
questions.explanation_en: मेहमान आ गए हैं and दुकान बंद थी — guests turned up and the shop was closed.

questions.question_en: Listen again. What has gone wrong?
options: He is in the wrong part of town
He was given the wrong address
He has already walked past the bank
questions.explanation_en: वो तो पीछे रह गया — the bank is behind him now.

questions.question_en: Across the auto dialogues, what does the driver end up charging for the station?
questions.explanation_en: पौने दो सौ — a quarter less than two hundred. And in the third auto dialogue the meter is broken, as it always is.

questions.question_en: बस, ट्रेन, कैब, टंकी and लाइन all behave the same way in these dialogues. What do they have in common?
options: They are all feminine, so the verbs around them are feminine
questions.explanation_en: All feminine — which is why you hear जाएगी, चली, बुक की, हो गई and पकड़नी. Loanwords get a gender assigned and nothing predicts it.

questions.question_en: के पास, के सामने and के लिए appear across these levels. Which pairing is right?
options: All three mean the same thing
के पास = for, के सामने = with, के लिए = near
के पास = near or in someone's keeping, के सामने = opposite, के लिए = for
के पास = opposite, के सामने = for, के लिए = near
questions.explanation_en: गार्ड के पास is in the guard's keeping, मेन गेट के सामने is opposite the gate, and लाजपत नगर के लिए is a ticket for that destination.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: अगले ___ पर रोक देना।
questions.explanation_en: पर is a postposition, so चौराहा goes oblique to चौराहे.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: मुझे एक दवा ___ है।
questions.explanation_en: दवा is feminine, so the infinitive in an obligation takes -नी.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: यहाँ ___ डाकघर कितनी दूर है?
questions.explanation_en: से marks the starting point; तक would ask about the far end.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: पैदल दस मिनट ___ हैं।
questions.explanation_en: मिनट is masculine plural, so the verb is plural.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: ___ पूरा दिन आराम किया है।
questions.explanation_en: करना is transitive and the tense is perfective, so ने.
